title: 導きの標となりしは智

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Sei! Yah! Hyah! Tah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Forty-five! Forty-six! Forty-seven!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Don't go easy on me today!
choice_data_list: Let's start with a paced run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer… Actually, if I may be so bold, I would like to stay and train some more on my own.
choice_data_list: All right. Remember to give me a summary of your exercises later.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Duly noted. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I have yet to obtain an obsession… and it remains unclear how to develop one.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (But it's more than likely an obsession driving Chiyono O and Ardan to run beyond their limits.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (If that's the case, I may be able to have an obsession myself by pushing harder…)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Right now, what I need to do is simply push myself to the extreme!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stop by the track on my way home after work. As I thought, Yaeno Muteki is still running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she's heeding my warning and doing her best not to push herself too far, I can't say I like what I'm seeing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can practically feel the mental strain she's under as if it were my own anxiety. It might be wise to shift her focus to something different.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's packed in here! There's still loads of time until the main event starts, though.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I mean, are you really surprised? This autumn Tenno Sho could be one to go down in history!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having invited Yaeno Muteki to watch the autumn Tenno Sho today, we're currently waiting for the race to start.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Who do you think's gonna win? Personally, I'm betting on Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's Oguri Cap for sure! Don't you want to see her take her first G1 title?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The sheer amount of attention surrounding Tamamo and Oguri is mind-blowing.
choice_data_list: They're saying this race will decide the peak of racing.
They're saying this race will decide the peak of racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is going to be a head-to-head duel between Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap, who have both been on the rise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The rivalry between them is quite similar to the relationship Yaeno Muteki has with Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I invited Yaeno to watch the race in the hopes that she might gain a hint on how to navigate her own plight.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There might come a day when I face off against them. I shall use this chance to study them intently.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Squeee! Oguri! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross! Give us another blowout victory!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The enthusiasm is so palpable it's fusing into the air itself!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But how are Tamamo and Oguri faring within this maelstrom of feverish excitement?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Talk about a perfect arena, huh, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Here's where we settle the ultimate question, once and for all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Which of us is da best there is!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've never put much thought into being "the best."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to beat you. I will beat you, plain and simple.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Oguri seems different from how she was at the Mainichi Hai.)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: They've crossed the 200-meter mark! Currently in the lead is Tamamo Cross! It's neck and neck between Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna tear right past da finish line! Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now's my chance! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap's in hot pursuit! Holding on to her lead, Tamamo Cross picks up speed! Tamamo Cross makes a run for it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Come on, come ooon! I gotta beat Tama!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is short by just a hair's breadth! Tamamo Cross wins! First place goes to Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haha! I did it! I won!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I won't lose next time!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Say what? Does that mean you're askin' for a rematch?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. No matter how many times it takes, I'll beat you!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit. Come at me however many times ya like!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oguri's obsession is…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To beat Tamamo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's nothing… Watching this match gave me a lot to think about. With the Osaka Hai coming up, I have to work just as hard as these two.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki smiles at me, but I also feel a hint of somberness from her. Is it just my imagination?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Obsession…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I assumed Oguri was free from the chains of obsession due to her calm demeanor.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (But…)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. No matter how many times it takes, I'll beat you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Without a doubt, she has an obsession.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Her feelings may not contain the rage of a wildfire, but they came through straight as a loosed arrow.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (And not just Oguri. Chiyono O as well. And Ardan.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (They've all refined their desire to accomplish their goals into pure obsession.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I'm the only one who's falling behind!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer said I can become stronger even without an obsession.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But to think that the divide between myself and those who have one could be this vast…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I don't want to yield victory to them. I want the strength to fell great opponents and show my grandparents how much I've improved!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: These raging emotions are right here in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So what am I lacking in order to have my own obsession?!
